detail.systemIntegrationAlert: This is the Ezkey system integration used for admin MFA. Admin enrollments are managed via the dedicated admin provisioning flow (Admins screen). Bulk actions and integration deletion are not available for this integration.
detail.enrollmentsEmpty: No enrollments for this integration yet.
detail.dangerZoneIntro: Mass operations affect every revocable enrollment under this integration, including in-flight and already deactivated verified enrollments. Use with extreme caution.
detail.retiredIntro: This integration is retired and hidden from day-to-day listings by default. Permanent deletion remains exceptional and is only possible once no enrollments remain.
detail.deleteIntro: Permanent deletion is exceptional. Retire first for historical preservation; delete only when the record is truly disposable and no enrollments remain.

operationalWarning.tenantInactive: Tenant is currently inactive — authentication will be blocked for this integration until the tenant is reactivated.

contextHelp.retireContent: Retiring removes this integration from normal listings and permanently revokes all its enrollments. The record is preserved for audit history. This action requires a reason and cannot be undone — only delete it after retirement if the record is truly disposable.
contextHelp.deleteContent: Permanent deletion erases this retired integration and all its historical data. Only delete when you are certain the record has no audit or compliance value. A reason is required.

danger.deactivateAllDescription: All active enrollments under this integration will be deactivated. Users will no longer be able to authenticate until reactivated.
danger.reactivateAllDescription: All deactivated enrollments under this integration will be reactivated.
danger.revokeAllDescription: All revocable enrollments under this integration will be PERMANENTLY and IRREVERSIBLY revoked, including CREATED, BOUND, and VERIFIED enrollments whether currently active or already deactivated. New enrollments must be created for re-enrolment.
danger.retireDescription: Retiring this integration removes it from normal day-to-day listings while preserving historical data. Revocable enrollments under this integration will be revoked as part of the retirement flow.
danger.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to permanently delete retired integration "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone and should remain exceptional.
